overview: This paper proposes ICQL, an offline reinforcement learning framework that formulates Q-learning as a contextual inference problem using linear Transformers to adaptively infer local Q-functions from retrieved similar transitions, achieving near-optimal policy extraction without explicit subtask labels.

modules.name: D4RL Data Processing Module
modules.description: Handles the loading, normalization, and structuring of D4RL offline datasets (MuJoCo, Adroit, Kitchen), converting raw trajectories into standardized transition tuples for training and retrieval.

modules.name: Context Retrieval Engine
modules.description: Implements the k-Nearest Neighbor search mechanism based on L2 or cosine distance to retrieve top-k similar transitions for a given query state. Supports pre-computation and caching of indices for efficient runtime lookup, and includes multiple retrieval strategies (State-Similar, Random, State-Similar-with-High-Reward).

modules.name: Feature Extractor Network
modules.description: Implements the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) feature map that projects state-action pairs into a bounded d-dimensional feature space using ReLU, Layer Normalization, and a final Tanh activation, providing inputs for the linear Transformer.

modules.name: In-Context Linear Transformer
modules.description: Implements the core linear attention mechanism with specific parameter matrices (P, G) and mask matrices. This module executes the multi-layer forward pass that mathematically corresponds to iterative in-context Temporal Difference (TD) learning updates on the retrieved context.

modules.name: Local Q-Function Estimator
modules.description: Integrates the feature extractor and the linear Transformer to output context-conditioned Q-values. Given a query state-action pair and its retrieved context transitions, it constructs the prompt matrix and returns the estimated local Q-value.

modules.name: Local V-Function Estimator
modules.description: Implements the context-conditioned Value function estimator similar to the Q-estimator, used to compute the expectile regression target for the IQL-based variant, ensuring value estimation is also localized to the retrieved context.

modules.name: ICQL-IQL Critic Training Module
modules.description: Computes the critic loss using expectile regression between the local Q-estimates and the target values derived from the local V-estimates, enforcing conservative value updates consistent with the Implicit Q-Learning paradigm.

modules.name: ICQL-IQL Policy Extraction Module
modules.description: Trains the policy network using advantage-weighted behavioral cloning, where the advantage is calculated from the local Q and V estimates, extracting high-value actions while staying close to the offline dataset distribution.

modules.name: ICQL-TD3+BC Critic Training Module
modules.description: Computes the TD3-style Bellman error loss for the critic using local Q-estimates and twin target networks, adapting the conservative Q-learning update to the localized, context-dependent Q-function.

modules.name: ICQL-TD3+BC Actor Training Module
modules.description: Optimizes the actor network by maximizing the local Q-value while applying a behavior cloning regularization term, balancing performance maximization with adherence to the offline dataset constraints.

modules.name: Training Loop Orchestration
modules.description: Manages the overall offline RL training pipeline, including batch sampling, context retrieval, forward passes through estimators, loss computation, backpropagation, gradient clipping, and optimizer steps across training iterations.

modules.name: Evaluation and Normalization Module
modules.description: Executes the deterministic evaluation of the learned policy in the target environments, collects episodic returns, and computes the D4RL normalized scores required for comparison with baseline methods.

modules.name: Ablation Study Controller
modules.description: Configures and runs controlled ablation experiments to analyze the impact of context length, the number of linear Transformer layers, different retrieval strategies, and architectural choices (e.g., Linear Transformer vs. MLP vs. Standard Transformer).

modules.name: Q-Value and Retrieval Visualization
modules.description: Generates analytical visualizations including t-SNE plots of Q-value distributions compared to online SAC oracles, histograms of distances between query and retrieved states, and layer-wise Q-estimate convergence plots to validate in-context learning dynamics.

modules.name: Configuration and Logging Infrastructure
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations (YAML parsing), tracks hyperparameters (expectile, temperature, etc.), and integrates with logging tools (e.g., TensorBoard, Wandb) for real-time monitoring of training metrics and checkpointing.
